summary: Practise GC method selection, chromatogram review and troubleshooting for oil and gas analysis. Explore the course outline and learning outcomes.
lede: Gas chromatography for oil and gas helps laboratory analysts, production chemists and process engineers review chromatograms and troubleshoot routine analytical problems. Training covers sample handling, calibration, peak identification and integration review, method selection using ISO 6974 and ASTM D1945, and checks for common issues such as baseline drift, retention-time shifts and poor resolution.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for oil and gas personnel who handle gas chromatography samples, interpret analytical results or use laboratory data in operating and quality decisions.
audience: Process Engineers using GC results to assess
modules: GC Analysis in Oil and Gas
prerequisites: Prior experience with oil and gas laboratory work or analytical testing is recommended. Basic familiarity with gas composition or laboratory quality-control records will help you apply the method and troubleshooting exercises. Coding or programming is not required.
